# list_available_llm_models_tool

> List all available LLM models that can be used when creating agents.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `agents` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=list_available_llm_models_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

List all available LLM models that can be used when creating agents. This tool helps discover
which LLM models are configured in the system and available for agent creation.

IMPORTANT: When creating an agent, you MUST specify an existing LLM model using its 
internal_identifier. Use this tool to find available models before using create_agent_tool.

Returns detailed information about each model including:
- Model internal_identifier (required for agent creation)
- LLM model name (llm_model_name) and description
- Provider name (resolved from the associated LlmModelProductType — e.g.
  'OpenAI', 'Anthropic', 'Google', 'Ollama')
- Agent usage count

Optional filter:
- provider_name: case-insensitive match against the provider's display
  name on the associated LlmModelProductType (e.g. 'openai', 'ollama')

Example usage flow:
1. Use list_available_llm_models_tool to see available models
2. Use list_available_prompts_tool to see available prompts (optional)
3. Use create_agent_tool with the chosen model's internal_identifier

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `provider_name` | string | no | Filter by the provider display name on the associated LlmModelProductType (case-insensitive substring match). Examples: openai, anthropic, google, ollama. |
